reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the well-known concept of passive film disruption/reformation from cavitation erosion (P5, P6) with the tribological role of oxide films as lubricious layers (P9, P13, P15, P18, P19, P20, P23, P24) and the demonstrated benefit of annealing on tribocorrosion resistance (P8, P10). It links these into a single, explicit kinetic balance mechanism for sliding tribo-corrosion of HEAs, which none of the individual passages states, and proposes a controlled comparison to isolate this mechanism.
